result.title: Goal-Branching LaCAM: Temporary Goals as Search Branches in Dense Multi-Agent Pathfinding
result.summary: LaCAM is a search-based solver for multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF) that runs a depth-first search over joint configurations, using PIBT to generate successors and lazily adding single-agent constraints to explore alternatives. Although LaCAM is complete, it can struggle on dense, corridor-heavy instances because extracting blocking agents from deadlocks requires coordinated moves of several agents, often away from their goals, which PIBT's greedy one-step successors rarely propose and which LaCAM can only reach by enumerating constraints one agent at a time. This paper proposes Goal-Branching, where blocking agents are given temporary goals, each tried as an additional branch of LaCAM's search. We examine random and corridor-aware rules for choosing these temporary goals and show that completeness is preserved for any such rule. On dense instances (60-90% of free cells occupied) of three maze and room maps, Goal-Branching solves 89% of instances against 44% for LaCAM*, and, on instances both solve, it finds a first solution 10-14x faster on maze-32-32-2 and room-32-32-4, and nearly 200x faster in median time at 75% density on room-32-32-4. Solution cost increases by 15-22% on instances both solve, while on open maps and the full MovingAI benchmark its solutions cost no more than those of LaCAM* and it is at most 3% slower.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 Goal-Branching：为造成死锁的阻塞智能体临时设定目标，并把这些目标作为 LaCAM 联合配置搜索的额外分支，在密集 MAPF 实例上以更高解代价换取显著提升的求解率与速度。
AI.relevance_reason: 「临时子目标作为搜索分支」与 LVR 中多步推理的子目标分解、备选分支枚举与回溯搜索在概念上可能有联系，可供核查能否把这种分支机制和完备性论证类推到 latent 推理状态搜索；但论文处于 MAPF 规划语境，与视觉表示和 VLM 无直接关系。
